name: bybit-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Bybit V5 public perp market data (mark price, open interest, 8h funding rate, funding history). Required by agents/funding-rate-harvester.md. Defaults to testnet endpoint; falls back to empty payloads (success:false) when BYBIT_API_KEY is unset so the funding-rate harvester can degrade gracefully to internal-perp-only.
